international.title: The Russian army’s secret death toll – podcast
international.summary: Vladimir Putin has always kept the number of soldiers killed in Ukraine a secret, but at one point 720 were dying in 24 hours. Pjotr Sauer reports. Send your comments and questions to tif.questions@theguardian.com Russia has kept the death toll of its soldiers in the Ukraine war a carefully guarded secret. Now documents leaked to the Guardian have revealed its true scale . The Guardian’s Russia affairs correspondent, Pjotr Sauer , tells Helen Pidd what reporters have discovered. Two groups of hackers accessed Russia’s main statistics database last month and discovered a cache of 11m death certificates that revealed nearly 500,000 Russian losses in Ukraine since 2022. Among these were 1,000 – the equivalent of a whole regiment – who took their own lives. Continue reading...
